title: Mistral provider does not have an option to disable parallel tool calls
body:
### Description

We're trying to forcefully disable parallel tool calls with Mistral provider, but we didn't see this option anywhere in this SDK. Any ideas on how to go about that?

We didn't see any options for this either with the Mistral provider nor with the AI core streamText() API.

Using the following doesn't seem to work:
```
      providerOptions: {
        mistral: {
          parallelToolCalls: false,
        },
      },
```

Thanks!

### AI SDK Version

"@ai-sdk/mistral": "2.0.14",
"@ai-sdk/openai": "2.030",
"ai": "5.0.44"

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
